task.task_name: Triage a personal auto collision claim
task.task_description: You handle new auto insurance claims. A policyholder reports a two-car collision at an intersection and sends in their account of what happened, vehicle details, damage photos, the other driver's contact and insurance information, and a police report number. Some details might be missing or conflicting, and there may not be a repair estimate yet. Your task is to check the claim against the policy and available records, see whether there's enough information to move it forward, flag missing documents or possible coverage issues, and send it to the right claims team. Straightforward claims can go through the usual process. Claims involving injuries, conflicting accounts, signs of possible fraud, or complicated coverage questions need specialist attention. You're getting the claim ready for an adjuster, who will make the final coverage and liability decisions.

operational_subtasks.subtask_name: Review collision facts and escalation indicators
operational_subtasks.description: Review the reported collision account, vehicle and party details, damage photos, and available police information; identify reported injuries, conflicting accounts, or signs that may warrant fraud review without deciding liability or whether fraud occurred.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumption: this review occurs for every claim and requires comparing several submitted sources; moderate effort per occurrence reflects the amount and consistency of information available. No workload measurements were supplied.

operational_subtasks.description: Check whether the submitted information and available records are sufficient to move the claim forward, and identify missing or unavailable details or documents, such as a repair estimate if needed.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumption: a sufficiency check is needed for every claim, with extra review when details or documents are missing; the effort per occurrence is generally modest but increases when the submission is incomplete. No operational frequency data was supplied.

operational_subtasks.subtask_name: Screen policy and records for coverage issues
operational_subtasks.description: Compare the claim facts with the applicable policy and available records to identify potential coverage issues or questions that require specialist review, without making the adjuster's final coverage decision.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumption: this screening occurs for every claim and typically requires reviewing policy terms alongside claim facts; effort per occurrence is moderate and rises when policy application is unclear. No measured workload or exception rate was supplied.

operational_subtasks.subtask_name: Select claims routing and hand off triage findings
operational_subtasks.description: Determine whether the claim follows the usual claims process or needs specialist attention based on injury, conflicting accounts, possible fraud indicators, or complicated coverage questions; send the assigned claims team the claim materials, sufficiency status, missing-item flags, and relevant concerns.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumption: routing and handoff occur once per claim and usually require a brief assignment and transfer of findings; specialist routing may add coordination, but no occurrence rate or measured effort was supplied.
